info.name: EruSentia Week 2 — Templates
info.description: Local management CRUD for week 2; App remains local-only. Run all requests in order. New HTML envelope matches current App fields; this collection does not execute HTML. Creates an isolated slug/tag, verifies persistence and errors, then soft-deletes its own row. No auth until week 3.

body.raw:
{ "authorId": "a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "categoryId": "c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "title": "Weekly learning planner", "slug": "{{runSlug}}", "description": "Reusable HTML planner for a learning week", "contentJson": { "format": "erusentia-template-html", "schemaVersion": 1, "html": "

", "originId": "local-weekly-planner", "guide": "Điền mục tiêu rồi chia nhỏ công việc theo ngày.", "iconName": "CalendarOutlined", "subjectCategory": "study", "level": "semi", "defaultWidth": "100%", "defaultHeight": "auto", "fitMode": "fit-page", "aspectRatio": "auto", "allowHeightResize": false }, "tags": [ "{{runSlug}}" ], "isPublic": false }

exec:
pm.test("HTML and all App metadata round-trip", () => pm.expect(body.contentJson).to.deep.eql({"format": "erusentia-template-html", "schemaVersion": 1, "html": "

Kế hoạch học tập

Mục tiêu tuần này

", "originId": "local-weekly-planner", "guide": "Điền mục tiêu rồi chia nhỏ công việc theo ngày.", "iconName": "CalendarOutlined", "subjectCategory": "study", "level": "semi", "defaultWidth": "100%", "defaultHeight": "auto", "fitMode": "fit-page", "aspectRatio": "auto", "allowHeightResize": false}));
pm.test("New template has zero views", () => pm.expect(body.viewsCount).to.eql(0));
pm.test("Isolated run contains exactly one row", () => pm.expect(body.totalElements).to.eql(1));
